-- ----------An counterexample found by VeriEQL------------
CREATE TABLE CUSTOMERS (
	CUSTOMERID INTEGER,
	SEGMENT VARCHAR(20),
	CURRENCY VARCHAR(20)
);
INSERT INTO CUSTOMERS VALUES (97, 'KAM', '2147483648');
INSERT INTO CUSTOMERS VALUES (98, 'SME', '2147483648');
INSERT INTO CUSTOMERS VALUES (96, 'LAM', '2147483648');
CREATE TABLE GASSTATIONS (
	GASSTATIONID INTEGER,
	CHAINID INTEGER,
	COUNTRY VARCHAR(20),
	SEGMENT VARCHAR(20)
);
INSERT INTO GASSTATIONS VALUES (0, 2, '2147483648', 'Other');
INSERT INTO GASSTATIONS VALUES (1, 1, '2147483648', 'Other');
INSERT INTO GASSTATIONS VALUES (2, 0, '2147483648', 'Premium');
CREATE TABLE PRODUCTS (
	PRODUCTID INTEGER,
	DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(20)
);
INSERT INTO PRODUCTS VALUES (1, '2147483648');
INSERT INTO PRODUCTS VALUES (0, '2147483648');
INSERT INTO PRODUCTS VALUES (2, '2147483648');
CREATE TABLE TRANSACTIONS_1K (
	TRANSACTIONID INTEGER,
	DATE DATE,
	TIME VARCHAR(20),
	CUSTOMERID INTEGER,
	CARDID INTEGER,
	GASSTATIONID INTEGER,
	PRODUCTID INTEGER,
	AMOUNT INTEGER,
	PRICE INTEGER
);
INSERT INTO TRANSACTIONS_1K VALUES (-2147483648, '0001-01-01', '2147483648', 98, 12150, 0, 2, 0, 1);
INSERT INTO TRANSACTIONS_1K VALUES (-2147483646, '0001-01-01', '2147483648', 99, 12150, 0, 2, 0, );
INSERT INTO TRANSACTIONS_1K VALUES (-2147483647, '0001-01-01', '2147483648', 96, 12150, 0, 2, 0, 2);
CREATE TABLE YEARMONTH (
	CUSTOMERID INTEGER,
	DATE VARCHAR(20),
	CONSUMPTION INTEGER
);
INSERT INTO YEARMONTH VALUES (98, '2147483648', 0);
INSERT INTO YEARMONTH VALUES (96, '2147483650', 1);
INSERT INTO YEARMONTH VALUES (98, '2147483649', );
-- ----------sql1------------
-- 96, 2147483648, 2
SELECT T1.CUSTOMERID, T1.CURRENCY, AVG(T2.PRICE) FROM CUSTOMERS AS T1 INNER JOIN TRANSACTIONS_1K AS T2 ON T1.CUSTOMERID = T2.CUSTOMERID GROUP BY T1.CUSTOMERID ORDER BY SUM(T2.PRICE) DESC LIMIT 1;
-- ----------sql2------------
-- 98, NULL, 2147483648
SELECT T2.CUSTOMERID, SUM(T2.PRICE / T2.AMOUNT), T1.CURRENCY FROM CUSTOMERS AS T1 INNER JOIN TRANSACTIONS_1K AS T2 ON T1.CUSTOMERID = T2.CUSTOMERID WHERE T2.CUSTOMERID = ( SELECT CUSTOMERID FROM YEARMONTH ORDER BY CONSUMPTION DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY T2.CUSTOMERID, T1.CURRENCY;
